purpose: Record the latest Binance aggregate restoration claim and synchronized XRP price/derivatives observations without converting aggregate reserve coverage or account ratios into XRP-specific flow or directional signals.

sources.title: XRP live liquidations, funding, open interest and long/short ratios
sources.notes: At 2026-10-31 16:32 UTC the page reports XRP at $1.25; rolling 24-hour liquidations $808K ($542K longs, $266K shorts); average funding +0.0036% per 8h and Binance +0.0100%; all-exchange open interest $1.33B, +0.9% over 24h; 73.0% of Binance XRP-position accounts long, 71.0% of Binance top-trader accounts long, and 61.5% of Hyperliquid accounts long. The provider says the page updates every few minutes.
sources.limitations: Provider methodology and contract universe are not independently audited. Account ratios are not notional exposure. Rolling 24-hour liquidations differ from UTC calendar-day totals; October 31 daily row is partial at capture. Do not average with other providers' OI without contract-level reconciliation.

independence_policy: Reuters is independent reporting of Binance's statement, not an audit of Binance reserves. Binance's own update remains a company claim. Liqwall and Binance market pages are separate provider observations; neither is treated as independent corroboration of the other's methodology.
